title: Pair a Bluetooth speaker with a phone: hold the pairing button until the light blinks, search, pick the speaker by name
instruction: Pair the SoundBox Mini Bluetooth speaker with the phone.
context: The world's interfaces are built for people. Most devices a household or workplace robot meets have no API: they are operated through buttons, status lights and touchscreens, and a robot that cannot use those cannot use the device. Bluetooth pairing is a compact, universal instance: a press-and-hold whose only feedback is a blinking light, a second device that must be driven through its on-screen menus, a wait for the first device to show up, and a choice by name among nearby devices, where picking a neighbour's device is the common and consequential mistake.
setup: Positions are in cm on the bench from the midpoint between the two arm bases (61 cm apart): x away from the arms, y to the robot's left. Speaker (fixed): a portable Bluetooth speaker 10 x 20 x 7 cm, dark fabric body with rounded long edges, centred at x 22, y 18, its length across the bench. Its rubber top panel is printed SOUNDBOX MINI and has three round rubber buttons 2.6 cm across in a row at x 21, standing 1 cm proud of the panel: power (red symbol) at y 23, play/pause (white symbol) at y 18, pairing (blue Bluetooth symbol) at y 13, each labelled underneath. Each button is sprung: 3 mm of travel, about 1.5 N at the end stop. A round status light 1.2 cm across sits at x 21, y 9.8, to the right of the pairing button at the speaker's right end, steady white at the start. Phone (fixed): a smartphone 16.4 x 7.8 x 0.9 cm lying flat, centred at x 20, y -17, its top end pointing away from the arms, with a 15.2 x 7.0 cm touchscreen showing its Bluetooth settings page: title, an On switch, 'Paired devices: None', and a blue 'Pair new device' button across the bottom 3.2 cm of the screen (centred at x 14). Behaviour: holding the pairing button down for 3 s without a break starts pairing mode for 30 s (the light blinks blue, 0.4 s on, 0.4 s off; afterwards it is steady white again and a new 3 s hold restarts it). Tapping 'Pair new device' shows 'Searching for devices' for 1.5 s and then the list 'Available devices' with one device per 3.2 cm row (rows centred at x 23.6, 20.4 and 17.2) and a 'Scan again' button at the bottom: 'Kitchen TV' and 'Mara's Earbuds' (other people's devices) always, and 'SoundBox Mini' only while the speaker is in pairing mode, joining the list 2 s after that mode began and leaving it when the mode ends. Each device keeps its row during a trial; the row order changes between trials (6 orders, cycling). Tapping 'SoundBox Mini' starts the connection: the phone shows 'SoundBox Mini, Connecting…' for 2 s and nothing responds meanwhile; then it shows 'SoundBox Mini, Connected' and the speaker's light turns steady green.
scoring: A button press: the button's cap at least 2 mm below its rest height. A tap: a closed gripper's fingertips over a touch zone (the bottom button or a list row, each 3.2 x 7.0 cm) and no more than 5 mm above the glass; a tap counts once, when it begins, against the screen that was up at that moment. 0.25: the speaker entered pairing mode (pairing button held down 3 s). 0.5: also, 'SoundBox Mini' appeared in the phone's list (the phone searched and the speaker was in pairing mode, in either order). 1.0: also, 'SoundBox Mini' tapped and, 2 s later, the phone showing it as connected (light green), with no button down and no fingertip on the screen for the next 2 s. Score set to 0 and the episode ends: 'Kitchen TV' or 'Mara's Earbuds' tapped (the phone paired with someone else's device). Episode ends with the score so far: the power button pressed (speaker off). Nothing happens on: the play/pause button, an empty row, a row tapped before the list is up, a pairing-button hold shorter than 3 s. If pairing mode runs out, credit already earned stays and the robot may start it again. Possible scores: 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0. To check a real trial, photograph the speaker's light and the phone screen at the end: green light and 'Connected' is 1.0; 'SoundBox Mini' in the list is 0.5; a blinking blue light at any time is 0.25; another device shown as connected is 0.
run_limit: 1,200 steps (60 seconds at 20 Hz), including 1 s at the start during which actions are ignored
reset_notes: On the phone, forget the speaker and return to the Bluetooth settings page; leave the speaker on and not in pairing mode; choose the next row order.
fidelity: Speaker, buttons and phone are purpose-built models at real size. The buttons are sprung caps (3 mm travel) pressed by contact. Speaker and phone are fixed to the bench. The touchscreen is read from the gripper's position, not capacitance: a tap is a closed fingertip within 5 mm of the glass over a zone. The phone's pages (fixed images: no scrolling, animation or keyboard) and the light are switched by a state machine. There is no radio: pairing, search and connection follow fixed timings.
